name: Demo 07: Donation thank-you (Google Sheets and Gmail)

parameters.content:
## Donation thank-you: full version
1. Open **New donation row** and **Ledger row**: connect Google Sheets and pick your sheet and tab.
2. Open both Gmail nodes and connect your Gmail.
3. Change the trustee address in **Trustee alert**.
4. Test with your own email in the sheet before you switch it on.
